text: Completed the one-layer unlit scalar reference and JavaFX feasibility slice locally. All 491 conformance tests pass; existing JVM/JS example checksum failure remains unchanged. Clean native run: 72 cases, 1,036,494 interior pixels. Affine calibration passes 24/24 within two channel values; piecewise 6/24 and threshold 2/24 meet the budget, so production native scalar support remains rejected. Next experiment: geometric partitions at mapping boundaries. Review, scoped patch, hashes, image, and archived logs are recorded in docs/plans/surface-scalar-fragments-review.md.
